about_the_game: The city of Porte Avant is a strange mixture of normal metropolitan life and open sexual promiscuity. In this demo, you (as the main character) will begin your adventure as a young man looking to start his life over in a new place. On the way to your destination, disaster strikes, and you’ll wake up in the tender care of Nurse Roo (one of the caretakers in Porte Avant’s illustrious St. Eros Hospital). She will explain your situation and offer some “intimate” help in your recovery. Whether you accept her offer or decline, her brand of TLC will give you an idea of what’s to come in this naughty new pit stop...

content_descriptors.notes: This game has adult themes, adult language, and fictional fantasy characters depicted in hardcore sexual situations/acts. All characters depicted are over the age of 18.
